en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large tree in the foreground and, in the distance across open fields, a complex of multi‑storey military barracks buildings. Printed red text at the upper right identifies the location as Freiberg in Saxony and specifies a barracks of the 3rd Battalion, 12th Infantry Regiment No. 177. Additional small red vertical text at the left margin gives the publisher's information.
